Mixtures remain non-equivalence diagnostics, not hard exclusions.
acceptance: Only accepted relation objects may change; labels, aliases, visible units, weights, applicability and affected properties remain exact.
Preserve the complete image regions for split toning, the red object AND achromatic remainder, and both subject interior/outline and bright background for silhouette.

Preserve frozen probes and trial results. Restore avoidable reverse-probe proposals without compensating demonstrated benefit; inspect score and crossing candidates for collateral rank movement before acceptance. No post-freeze query tuning.
No hard exclusions for potentially coexisting effects. Owner correctness rests on source/projection evidence, not rank alone.
limitations: Small authored English diagnostics, not a blind or multilingual benchmark.
Original research maintenance records bind their source ledgers and remain immutable.
